issue_request: FHIR-39597 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Consent and requested eliminating provision zero by moving Consent.provision.type to Consent.decision, changing Consent.provision to 0..*, and adjusting notes to remove provision-zero references.
initial_application: PR #2616 applied the main change: e8f77ac72e93779d5ff23eda48ac3445f8a0e64c moved Consent.provision.type to Consent.decision, changed Consent.provision to 0..*, and updated examples and introductory text; 41247a9aec0715d6216405dbdcd9367fe0d1a230 revised the Provisions narrative; cdd3f8411032f745848622236e70b0129ba83bce merged the PR.
additional_context: Consent is active in source/fhir.ini. Current StructureDefinition and narrative already define Consent.decision as the base decision and Consent.provision as 0..*, but two authoritative notes still pointed base decision or consent-wide period guidance at Consent.provision/a base provision. FHIR-34322 is the earlier same-family provision-model documentation issue superseded in part by FHIR-39597. FHIR-55728 is a later R6 Resolved - change required issue about making Consent.decision mandatory when provisions exist and was treated as context only in this default Applied/Published run. Zulip had one announcement thread for the proposed FHIR-39597 change; Confluence had no direct reference.
reconciliation: Updated source/consent/consent-notes.xml so the Optimal Searching guidance directs readers to Consent.decision for the base permit/deny decision associated with Consent.policyBasis. Updated source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml so Consent.provision.period no longer says consent-wide effective time belongs in a base provision; it now points to Consent.period for consent-wide effective time and treats provision.period as provision-specific.
source_changes: source/consent/consent-notes.xml: changed the Optimal Searching guidance from Consent.provision to Consent.decision for the base permit/deny decision associated with Consent.policyBasis.
